exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Sniffing
exploitedBy.relevance: Unencrypted database transport allows attackers to capture credentials and query data via network sniffing.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Downgrade Attack
exploitedBy.relevance: Weak or deprecated TLS versions can be exploited through downgrade attacks to force use of vulnerable cipher suites.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Weaken Encryption
exploitedBy.relevance: Using deprecated TLS versions directly weakens encryption strength, enabling interception of communications.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Install Root Certificate
exploitedBy.relevance: Bypassing TLS certificate validation can be achieved by installing rogue root certificates to perform man-in-the-middle attacks.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal or Forge Authentication Certificates
exploitedBy.relevance: Certificate validation bypass enables attackers to forge or misuse certificates to impersonate trusted endpoints.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
exploitedBy.relevance: Plaintext fallback may allow data exfiltration over unencrypted alternative protocol channels.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Application Exhaustion Flood
exploitedBy.relevance: Lack of rate and query throttling leaves the database application vulnerable to exhaustion floods that degrade or deny service.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Service Exhaustion Flood
exploitedBy.relevance: Without throttling, attackers can flood database connections to exhaust service resources.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Internal Proxy
exploitedBy.relevance: An unencrypted connection pooler segment acts as an internal proxy where traffic can be intercepted or manipulated.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Boundary Bridging
exploitedBy.relevance: BGP route injection can bridge network boundaries to intercept traffic that would otherwise be isolated.
